provenance.note: position stats and marker candidates are both derived mechanically from this treebank's own gold dependency annotations — never hand-typed or asserted from general linguistic knowledge. A marker candidate is admitted only when its real precision beats the (1-alpha) quantile of a within-sentence role-label shuffle (II.23), never a fixed ratio — and (S122) that quantile is the MAX-STATISTIC across every eligible closed-class candidate tried, not a per-candidate null, so the admitted marker is significant against the whole search, not merely against itself.
